mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders_rights ( user_id, company_id, can_reservation, rights_name, rights_subname, total_num, total_consum_num, start_time, end_time, order_id, label_infos, rights_from, operator_desc, mobile, status, is_not_limit_num, created, updated ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CAST(#{userId} AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, i.company_id AS company_id, 0 AS can_reservation, i.item_name AS rights_name, '' AS rights_subname, IFNULL(CAST(#{itemRow.num,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS SIGNED), 1) AS total_num, 0 AS total_consum_num, CASE i.date_type WHEN 'DATE_TYPE_FIX_TIME_RANGE' THEN IFNULL(i.begin_date, 0) ELSE UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00')) END AS start_time, CASE i.date_type WHEN 'DATE_TYPE_FIX_TIME_RANGE' THEN IFNULL(i.end_date, 0) ELSE UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL IFNULL(i.fixed_term, 0) DAY), ' 23:59:59')) END AS end_time, 0 AS order_id, CONCAT( '[', IFNULL( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(JSON_OBJECT('label_id', r2.label_id, 'label_name', r2.label_name) SEPARATOR ',') FROM items_rel_type r2 WHERE r2.item_id = i.item_id), ''), ']' ) AS label_infos, IFNULL(NULLIF(#{itemRow.rights_from,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '注册赠送') AS rights_from, '' AS operator_desc, #{mobilePlain} AS mobile, 'valid' AS status, 2 AS is_not_limit_num, UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS created, UNIX_TIMESTAMP() AS updated FROM items i WHERE i.item_id = #{itemRow.item_id} AND i.company_id = #{companyId} AND i.item_type = 'services' AND i.consume_type = 'all' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(#{userId} AS UNSIGNED), i.company_id, 1, i.item_name, rt.label_name, IFNULL(rt.num, 0) * IFNULL(CAST(#{itemRow.num,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS SIGNED), 1), 0, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00')), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL IFNULL(rt.limit_time, 0) DAY), ' 23:59:59')), 0, CONCAT('[', JSON_OBJECT('label_id', rt.label_id, 'label_name', rt.label_name), ']'), IFNULL(NULLIF(#{itemRow.rights_from,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), '注册赠送'), '', #{mobilePlain}, 'valid', IFNULL(rt.is_not_limit_num, 2), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), UNIX_TIMESTAMP() FROM items i INNER JOIN items_rel_type rt ON rt.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.item_id = #{itemRow.item_id} AND i.company_id = #{companyId} AND i.item_type = 'services' AND i.consume_type = 'every' ) u
